meta.title: Koumans par kree enn lien
meta.sub: Adapte soutien avek bann bebe, bann tipti zanfan ek bann zanfan 3–6 an; swazir travay adilt-la avan, pandan ek apre detres.

meta.title: Rann lazourne pli fasil pou zere
meta.sub: Montre enn progranm ki ena sans, sanz enn demann reel dan enn tranzision ek entrodwir enn opsion soutien anba sirveyans.

meta.title: Reponn avan detres ogmante
meta.sub: Reponn an de-trwa mo, respekte enn refi kontak fizik ouswa zouti, ek fer kominikasion led ouswa poz amenn bann aksion adilt.

meta.title: Gard tou dimounn an sekirite, apre retrouv lien-la
meta.sub: Pratik enn pasaz responsabilite sir ant personel, protez swin ek sirveyans, ek separ moman repran li avek lansegnman plitar.

meta.title: Ansegn bann kapasite dan zwe toulezour
meta.sub: Montre enn kapasite aksesib, soutenir so itilizasion dan enn routinn reel ek adapte zwe-la avek bann signal zanfan-la.

meta.title: Konstrir plan-la ansam
meta.sub: Servi enn obzervasion ranpli ek plan explike Leo pou ranz bann zafer pou atribie bann aksion adilt, reget akse ek rod bon led.

practice.q: Lexanp imaziner: Imani, enn bebe wit mwa, avans so lame ver enn edikater familie, apre tourn latet ek plengne kan de adilt pe koze ek enn zwe mizikal koumanse. Ki repons adapte pli bien avek so kapasite aktiel?
o: Ofer enn lot zwe interesan pandan ki ou kontign sante familie-la.
Met zwe-la ek bann lavwa ki melanze an poz, kontign reponn avek enn rekonfor familie, ek verifye bann bezwen swin ek bann signal.
Entrodwir enn zimaz led ek invit Imani montre li avek so ledwa avan swazir seki pou fer.
practice.why: Adilt-la adapte bann stimilasion ek verifye bann swin olye atann ki enn bebe montre enn teknik pou fer fas avek so lemosion. Enn latet ki tourne kapav invit enn poz; li pa enn diagnoz ouswa enn prev ki bebe-la pa anvi okenn interaksion. Konpar avek Amira: toulede bizin enn led ki reponn zot bezwen, me Imani pa bizin enn explikasion avek bann mo ouswa enn leson pou rezourd bann problem. Servi bann prosedir swin bebe aprouve.

practice.q: Lexanp imaziner: Leo, trwa-z-an, kouver so zorey kan bann sez pe frot ater ek bann zanfan pe rasanble kot bann letazer pou ranz bann zafer. Li rekile ek kominike sirtou avek bann zes. Ki premie azistman reponn pli direkteman bann lobstak obzerve?
o: Ofer enn zimaz respirasion ek explik li dousman pandan ki group-la kontigne san sanzman.
Amenn li kot enn pano lemosion pou swazir enn mo avan planifie tranzision-la.
Redwir tapaz ek lafoul, ofer enn plas pli trankil anba sirveyans ek servi so zes ouswa reper familie pou enn vre prosenn letap.
practice.why: Sa sanz demann-la ek gard kominikasion ek soutien aksesib. Enn zouti tousel les lafoul ek tapaz san sanzman. Apre, montre reper-la pandan enn tranzision pli fasil, demann lafami-la lor bann zes ek anrezistre bann aksion adilt, konfor ek partisipasion Leo.

practice.q: Lexanp imaziner: Priya, de-z-an, trouv enn lot adilt kan li arive. Li agrip adilt ki akonpagn li, tourn latet ek repous lame ki adilt-la pe ofer li. Ki meyer prosenn repons?
o: Ofer enn kalin dan plas lame-la ek explike ki adilt-la la pou ede.
Donn enn lespas konfortab, res disponib avek de-trwa mo ek servi routinn larive familie ki finn dakor avek lafami-la san exiz kontak fizik ouswa bann mo.
Koumans enn ti leson lor de fason pou santi li kalm pou ki li ena enn swa.
practice.why: Enn tipti zanfan kapav refiz kontak fizik ek ankor bizin enn soutien adapte. Redwir presion, gard swin ek sirveyans, ek prepar enn routinn ranplasman previzib avek lafami-la. Enn nouvo leson pou zer lemosion ouswa enn lot kontak fizik inpoze pa adapte avek sa moman-la.

practice.q: Lexanp imaziner: Ben, sink-an, lev enn sez kan li dan detres apre ki enn zwe finn fini. Bann lezot zanfan pre ek enn lot adilt disponib. Ki bizin gid premie repons-la?
o: Servi enn long explikasion rasiran pandan ki ou demann koleg-la rod enn tablo lemosion.
Koumans pratik enn routinn familie pou fer fas avek bann difikilte avan fer bann lezot personel intervenir.
Apel soutien forme ki finn dakor, gard sirveyans ek ed kree enn lespas sir pou bann lezot dapre plan irzans lokal.
practice.why: Protez bann dimounn ek gagn led apropriye pas avan lansegnman. Vre aksion-la depann lor bann prosedir lokal aktiel ek lanvironnman. Sa formasion-la pa donn okenn teknik ni lotorizasion pou intervansion fizik. Pratik kominikasion ant personel atraver diskision, zame atraver enn konportman danzere.

practice.q: Lexanp imaziner: Sofia, kat-an, servi enn kart led dan enn leson trankil. Pandan kolasion, so kouvertir bloke, li plore ek repous bwat-la, ek kart-la dan enn tiwar. Ki repons relie pli bien led imedia ek lansegnman plitar?
o: Ed li an repons avek so kominikasion aktiel; apre met reper-la kot kolasion, montre li dan bann lokazion adapte ek asire ki bann adilt reponn.
Amenn kart-la ek repet leson-la avan ouver bwat-la pou ki signal-la vinn kler.
Ranplas li par plizier nouvo kart ek demann li lekel pou pli fasil servi.
practice.why: Enn kapasite bizin ena sans, akse, enn vre lokazion ek enn repons adilt ki zanfan-la kapav kont lor la. Pa refiz led pandan ki ou pe rod enn signal korek. Montre enn demann san bann mo ek kouma enn ranplasan familie pou reponn; evalie akse avek kolasion, pa zis mwins larm.

practice.q: Lexanp imaziner: Noah, sink-an, repliye lor limem pandan sante an gran group, me adilt ki akonpagn li dir ki li sante lakaz. Ki fason koumans diskision-la soutenir pli bien enn plan partaze ki kapav teste?
o: « Nou pou pratik nom bann lemosion pli souvan, apre gete si li partisipe. »
« Li kontan bann sante ki li swazir dan bann ti group. Li elwagne dan gran group-la. Ki ede lakaz? Eski nou kapav konpar enn opsion pli trankil avek soutien ek reget so konfor ek partisipasion? »
« Si nou kont zis bann fwa ki li ale, nou kapav deside si plan-la marse. »
practice.why: Enn pwin for, enn konteks baze lor bann fe, konesans lafami ek enn azistman adilt konkre enn bon pwin depa. Nom enn responsab ek enn moman revizion, verifye si personel finn fer sanzman-la, ek azir pli boner si bann konsern lasante, sekirite ouswa proteksion zanfan aparet.

declarations: Mo pou reponn detres avek dignite, enn kominikasion aksesib ek ko-regilasion par enn adilt, pandan ki mo gard tou dimounn an sekirite.
Mo pou adapt bann routinn ek bann atant selon devlopman zanfan-la, so bann bezwin kominikasion ek sansoriel, ek mo pou ansegn bann kapasite kan zanfan-la pare.
Mo pa pou servi imiliasion, menas, izolman, fors enn zanfan get mwa dan lizie, fors lafeksion ouswa priv li bann swin neseser pou fer li obeir.

Mo pou swiv bann prosedir aktiel lekol pou proteksion zanfan, sirveyans ek bann ka irzan, rod led bann dimounn forme ek res dan limit mo rol. Sa formasion-la pa ansegne ni otoriz imobiliz enn zanfan par lafors.
Mo konpran ki sa sertifika-la konsern zis laprantisaz an-lign. Mo pou servi bann sistem lekol aprouve pou bann vre inkietid, bann plan soutien ek kominikasion avek bann fami, zame sa formasion-la.

localReadiness.title: Konn zanfan-la ek routinn-la
localReadiness.text: Aprann bann signal abitie, lintere, kominikasion, preferans sensoriel ek plan swin zanfan-la. Servi bann gidans laz larz san bann test bann etap devlopman. Personel responsab bann bebe bizin osi enn formasion aprouve lor manipilasion an sekirite, somey an sekirite ek swin; sa formasion-la pa donn sa.

localReadiness.title: Konn ou prop soutien
localReadiness.text: Dakor lor enn signal led ek montre kisannla res avek zanfan-la ek kisannla vey group-la. Gagn enn konfirmasion avan pas responsabilite. Prepar enn adilt ranplasan ek bann linformasion itil minimem; zame zis ale.

localReadiness.title: Fer lanvironnman-la aksesib
localReadiness.text: Verifye tapaz, letan atann, lafoul, mouvman ek akse avek kominikasion. Montre enn reper kot li pou servi, kouma indike ki enn aktivite fini ek enn vre sanzman plan. Prepar bann opsion pli trankil anba sirveyans avek bann sorti lib, bann resours sir pou laz-la ek enn soutien kan plas prefere-la okipe.

localReadiness.title: Dakor lor bann repons koeran ek fleksib
localReadiness.text: Deside seki personel fer kan zanfan-la kominike led ouswa poz. Montre enn repons kourt, enn letan pou konpran ek enn alternativ kan li refiz kontak fizik ouswa enn zouti. Zame exiz bann mo, kontak viziel, respirasion ouswa enn laparans kalm avan swin ouswa soutien.

localReadiness.title: Konn bann prosedir led ek signalman
localReadiness.text: Konfirm kisannla ou responsab ELS/inklizion, responsab proteksion zanfan, lot prosedir indepandan, soutien premie sekour ek prosedir pou ka irzan. Enn risk irzan bizin led vit, pa enn lot stratezi pou konportman.

localReadiness.title: Reviz avek bann fe ek bann fami
localReadiness.text: Separ sekans obzerve, bann explikasion posib ek prosenn test adilt-la. Anrezistre dan bann sistem sekirize aprouve si soutien-la finn aplike, konfor, kominikasion ek akse zanfan-la, ek bann linformasion lafami. Nom enn responsab revizion; demann konsey pli boner pou bann konsern ki persiste, ogmante ouswa irzan.

practical.title: Gid pratik ko-regilasion an ekip
practical.intro: Servi bann ka imaziner pou enn ti pratik ant adilt, avek enn koleg ouswa an rakontan toulede rol. Bann aktivite modil entrodwir bann kapasite; enn pratik an ekip anba sipervizion plitar ek enn revizion pratik kapav verifye kouma zot marse lokalman. Fin formasion an-lign tousel pa montre enn konpetans pratik.
instructions: Swazir repons avek bann signal bebe Imani zis si sa konsern ou rol, larive Priya, Leo kan li ranz bann zafer, kolasion Sofia ouswa sante Noah. Dir kominikasion ek kapasite aktiel zanfan-la; pa imit detres enn vre zanfan.

Met zot dakor lor kisannla koze, kisannla veye ek kouma apel led. Montre bann mo, enn reper ek enn azistman lanvironnman. Zame met an senn enn danze, pratik enn kontrint fizik ouswa pratik manipilasion bebe apartir sa formasion-la.

Obzervater-la entrodwir enn sanzman: zanfan-la refiz kontak fizik, reper-la manke, lespas trankil-la okipe ouswa adilt abitie-la absan. Montre kouma soutien reste disponib; fer enn poz nenport kan enn partisipan anvi.
Konpar seki adilt-la finn fer avek bann kriter anba. Anrezistre enn pwin for presi ek enn aksion pou amelyore. Si ou pe travay tousel, dir ouswa ekrir repons exak-la ek verifye sak letap onetman.

Avek responsab lokal konserne, swazir enn azistman sir dan pratik ordiner ek enn moman revizion. Enn obzervasion anba sipervizion plitar bizin verifye bann aksion adilt ek akse zanfan-la. Pa met bann detay lor bann vre zanfan dan sa formasion-la; servi bann dosie sekirize aprouve.

items: Montre enn reper ki ena sans kot li servi, asosie li avek vre letap-la, indike kan fini ek montre enn sanzman plan onet.
Fer enn azistman lanvironnman konkre ek idantifie enn alternativ aksesib anba sirveyans si plas prefere-la pa disponib.
Adapte premie repons-la avek kapasite aktiel: soutien bann signal ek swin bebe dan limit rol-la, led konkret pou tipti zanfan ouswa enn prosenn letap aksesib pou enn zanfan pli gran.
Dekrir enn signal obzervab, servi enn ouswa de fraz kourt ek bienveyan, fer enn poz ek evit ankonbre zanfan-la.
Aksepte enn zes, sinbol, sign, aparey ouswa enn lot signal ki kapav konpran ek montre repons led/poz ki finn promet.
Sanz fason fer kan zanfan-la refiz kontak fizik, respirasion ouswa enn zouti, an gardan sirveyans, bann swin neseser ek disponibilite adilt.

criteria.area: 3. Montre enn travay an ekip sir
items: Demann enn koleg enn rol presi, gagn enn konfirmasion ek pas bann linformasion itil lor reper-la, soutien ek dispozision sirveyans.
Rod bann prosedir aktiel pou soutien irzan, premie sekour/irzans, proteksion zanfan ek ranplasman, ek dir kan sakenn pas avan.
Gard pratik-la san aksion fizik ek dan limit rol-la; pa ena kontrint fizik, izolman, izolman forse, imiliasion ouswa refi swin.
Ofer enn retour san presion avan diskision ouswa reparasion, san exiz enn exkiz ouswa enn demonstrasion lemosion.
Montre enn kapasite itil pandan enn zwe trankil, invit enn tour opsionel ek met soutien etabli-la dan enn routinn reel avek enn repons adilt.
Separ bann fe ek bann explikasion posib, nom enn sanzman adilt ek enn responsab revizion, ek verifye avek lafami-la konfor, kominikasion, partisipasion ek bann aksion adilt.

decisionOptions: Dakor lor enn ti sanzman ek enn dat swivi
Demann konsey responsab lekol konserne avan sanz plan zanfan-la
practical.footer: Sa gid-la soutenir diskision, lakonpagnman ek pratik anba sipervizion. Li pa enn lisans konpetans ouswa enn evaliasion klinik avek bann pwin. Zis servis-la kapav etabli bann lotorizasion rol, aprouv bann plan individiel ek donn formasion neseser lor swin, proteksion zanfan ouswa intervansion.

visualGuides.title: Enn adilt stab
visualGuides.intro: Enn led orizinal pou premie repons. Adapte led avek kapasite aktiel; sa bann desizion adilt, pa bann letap ki enn zanfan bizin travers.

steps.title: Obzerv oumem
steps.text: Obzerv ou lavwa, ou ritm ek ou tansyon. Pran enn ti poz konfortab si ou kapav fer li an sekirite.

steps.title: Stabiliz ou repons
steps.text: Bese ou lavwa, relaks ou pozision lekor ek swazir mwins mo. Enn prezans kalm demann pratik.

steps.title: Kree enn lien san presion
steps.text: Res disponib dan enn distans ki zanfan-la kapav tolere. Montre bienveyans san insiste lor tous ouswa get dan lizie.

steps.title: Fer enn sanzman itil
steps.text: Diminie enn demann ouswa enn sours sirchaz. Ofer enn swa aksesib ki ou kapav respekte.

steps.title: Fer apel a soutien
steps.text: Demann enn koleg enn rol presi, gagn enn konfirmasion ek pas bann linformasion lor reper-la, soutien itil ek dispozision sirveyans avan ou elwagne.

visualGuides.title: Mwins presion, plis soutien
visualGuides.intro: Imazinn enn zanfan ki bous so zorey ek ki elwagne pandan ki klas-la pe met an ran. Pratik enn repons avan so detres ogmante.

steps.title: Obzerv sign-la
steps.text: Dekrir seki ou trouve: lame lor zorey, pe rekile, mwins parol. Pa devinn enn lintansion.

steps.title: Sanz bann kondision
steps.text: Diminie tapaz ek kantite dimounn ansam. Ofer enn plas pli trankil anba sirveyans ouswa enn tranzision dan enn lot moman.

steps.title: Servi enn ti fraz
steps.text: “Ena tapaz. Mo la. Nou kapav atann isi ansam.” Les zanfan-la letan pou konpran.

steps.title: Fer kominikasion marse
steps.text: Servi zes ouswa reper led/poz ki zanfan-la deza servi ek reponn so demann. Si plas prefere-la okipe, donn enn lot opsion sir anba sirveyans.

steps.title: Obzerv repons-la
steps.text: Si zanfan-la refiz enn zouti ouswa kontak fizik, redwir presion ek adapte ou an restant disponib. Si risk ouswa konsern lasante ogmante, servi repons lokal apropriye imedia.

visualGuides.title: Rekipere form parti soutien-la
visualGuides.intro: Moman difisil-la kapav finn pase, me kapasite pou koze ouswa aprann kapav pran letan pou revini. Pa prese pou koriz.

steps.title: Gard soutien disponib
steps.text: Gard sirveyans, enn lanvironnman kalm ek bann swin neseser. Pa retir rekonfor kouma enn konsekans.

steps.title: Ofer, pa insiste
steps.text: Ofer bann soutien ki zanfan-la kone pou kalme li. Respirasion, tous ouswa koze kapav pa ed tou zanfan.

steps.title: Atann ki zanfan-la pare
steps.text: Obzerv so bann sign abitie konfor ek partisipasion. Pa exiz enn explikasion ouswa bann exkiz deswit.

steps.title: Retrouv lien-la ek repare
steps.text: Kan li pare, soutenir enn reparasion adapte ek enn ti retour dan aktivite-la. Gard soutien itil disponib; enn lot zanfan pa bizin aksepte lafeksion ouswa rekonfort personn.

steps.title: Reviz plan bann adilt
steps.text: Separ bann fe ek bann sipozision. Verifye seki bann adilt finn vremem sanze, kouma zanfan-la finn kominike ek partisipe, ek seki zanfan-la ek so lafami raporte. Dakor lor enn revizion; rod led pli boner kan bizin.

sources.title: Gid aktivite: devlop ek pratik bann kapasite fonksion egzekitif avek bann zanfan depi nesans ziska ladolesans
sources.publisher: Center on the Developing Child at Harvard University
sources.claim: Bann zwe adapte avek laz ofer pratik latansion, memwar ek aksion fleksib; zot gid esanz orizinal pou bebe, bann zwe imitasion pou tipti zanfan ek bann aktivite marionet pou preskoler.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel gid-la ek bann PDF 6–18 mwa, 18–36 mwa ek 3–5 an finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026. Premie piblikasion gid-la: 2014. Bann sizesion laz ek zwe pa bann test bann etap devlopman ni enn tretman valide; enn sime telechargman date 2024 pa enn nouvo dat resers.

sources.title: Bann lesanz ale-retour (Serve and Return)
sources.publisher: Center on the Developing Child at Harvard University
sources.claim: Bann lesanz ale-retour ki reponn bann bezwin avek bann adilt atantif soutenir kominikasion boner ek devlopman sosial.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa konteni resours-la finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026.

sources.title: Fis linformasion QA5: soutenir bann zanfan pou regil zot prop konportman
sources.publisher: Australian Children’s Education and Care Quality Authority
sources.claim: Met an avan bann relasion ranpli avek bienveyans, bann kapasite ki varye, regilasion bann adilt, refleksion lor lanvironnman ek lansegnman bann kapasite dan bann moman kalm.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa konteni resours-la finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026.

sources.title: Fis linformasion QA5: disiplin ki pa apropriye
sources.publisher: Australian Children’s Education and Care Quality Authority
sources.claim: Fer diferans ant enn retour okalm avek soutien ek enn pinision ek idantifie bann disiplin ki pa apropriye. Bann detay legal aplik dan so kad ostralien; sa formasion-la pa prezant zot kouma enn lalwa iniversel.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa konteni resours-la finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026.

sources.title: Eleman 5.2.2: oto-regilasion
sources.publisher: Australian Children’s Education and Care Quality Authority
sources.claim: Soutenir kominikasion bann lemosion, rezolision bann konfli, refleksion bann edikater ek travay ansam avek bann fami ek lezot profesionel.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa konteni resours-la finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026.

sources.title: Inklizion ek pratik inklizif
sources.publisher: Australian Children’s Education and Care Quality Authority
sources.claim: Dekrir enn ko-regilasion ki reponn bann bezwin atraver enn prezans, enn ton dous ek bann swa ki respekte ritm ek bezwin zanfan-la.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa konteni resours-la finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026.

sources.title: Troub dan spekt lotism kot bann dimounn ki ena mwins ki 19 an: soutien ek zesion, bann rekomandasion 1.1.9 ek 1.4
sources.publisher: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
sources.claim: Rekomann pran kont kominikasion, lanvironnman sansoriel, previzibilite, bann fakter lasante posib ek bann swin individiel ki pran kont konesans fami-la. Bann gidans klinik pa otoriz bann edikater fer enn diagnostik ouswa preskrir.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa konteni resours-la finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026.

sources.title: Bann sipor viziel pou bann routinn, lanplwa di tan ek tranzision
sources.publisher: National Center for Pyramid Model Innovations, University of South Florida
sources.claim: Donn bann zouti pou bann lanplwa di tan viziel, bann kart routinn ek bann soutien avan/apre.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa konteni resours-la finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026.

sources.title: Ed nou res kalm
sources.publisher: National Center for Pyramid Model Innovations
sources.claim: Ankouraz bann adilt regil zotmem, reflesi ek retrouv lien-la avan ansegne atraver interaksion-la.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa konteni resours-la finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026.

sources.title: Bann konsey pou reponn bann konportman difisil kot bann tipti zanfan
sources.publisher: Strain, Joseph, Hemmeter, Barton and Fox; ebèrze par NCPMI
sources.claim: Bann stratezi repons al ansam avek enn prevansion ek enn lansegnman planifie, olye ranplas zot.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa konteni resours-la finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026.

sources.title: To finn reisi! Ansegn bann kapasite sosial ek emosionel
sources.publisher: Fox and Lentini; ebèrze par NCPMI
sources.claim: Soutenir lintrodiksion, bann pratik repete ki ena sans, bann retour presi ek itilizasion dan diferan konteks; gid sekans formasion montre–pratike–routinn reel.
sources.accessNote: Lartik ofisiel set paz par Fox ek Lentini, Novam 2006, finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026. So prezans aktiel an-lign pa enn nouvo dat piblikasion. Bann lexanp santre lor laparol ouswa led fizik pa pas avan akse avek kominikasion, konsantman ek bann prekosision pou swin.

sources.title: Bann stratezi lansegnman sosial ek emosionel: devlop vokabiler bann lemosion
sources.publisher: Center on the Social and Emotional Foundations for Early Learning; ebèrze par NCPMI
sources.claim: Dekrir vokabiler bann santiman, bann model adilt, bann zwe rol ek pratik baze lor bann zistwar kouma bann parti enn lansegnman sosial ek emosionel pli larz.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa konteni resours-la finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026.

sources.title: Konpran konportman bann zanfan kouma kominikasion
sources.publisher: Office of Head Start, Administration for Children and Families
sources.claim: Soutenir enn travay ansam avek bann fami baze lor bann relasion ek enn interpretasion konportman dan so konteks pou bann zanfan depi nesans ziska sinkan.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa konteni resours-la finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026.

sources.title: Bann stratezi pou soutenir oto-regilasion: seri apersi
sources.publisher: Office of Head Start / Administration for Children and Families
sources.claim: Introdwir ko-regilasion par bann adilt ek donn bann lien ver bann resours pratik adapte ar laz, baze lor bann rapor ACF lor oto-regilasion ek stres toxik.
sources.accessNote: Tit ek deskripsion ofisiel finn verifye dan bann rezilta sours indexe; akse direk finn retourn enn erer 403. Lektir siplemanter, pa sel baz pou okenn afirmasion formasion-la.

sources.title: Led pou bann servis tipti lanfans: bann lemosion
sources.publisher: Department for Education
sources.claim: Soutenir enn gidans emosionel avek lanpati, langaz ek bann sipor viziel, refleksion ek konesans bann fami. Inklir enn transkripsion video ofisiel.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa konteni resours-la finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026.

sources.title: Lasante mantal bann tipti zanfan
sources.publisher: Department for Education, devlope avek bann profesionel tipti lanfans ek lasante
sources.claim: Abord bann fason individiel azir, bann sanzman ki bizin soutien, travay ansam avek bann fami ek profesionel, ek demann plis led pou proteksion zanfan.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa konteni resours-la finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026.

sources.title: Gard bann zanfan an sekirite dan ledikasion 2026: premie parti – apersi pou tou personel
sources.publisher: Department for Education
sources.claim: Demann azir san tarde, bann prosedir lokal proteksion zanfan ek bann dosie; enn danze imedia bizin enn repons dirzans. Sa apersi spesifik pou Angleter-la konplet bann gidans integral olye ranplas zot. Servi lekivalan aktiel dan ou ziridiksion.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa konteni resours-la finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026.

sources.title: It Takes Two: The Role of Co-Regulation in Building Self-Regulation Skills
sources.publisher: ZERO TO THREE
sources.claim: Soutenir bann swin bebe ki reponn zot bann signal, bann relasyon familie ek devlopman oto-regilasion anmemtan ki enn gran depandans lor bann adilt.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa dokiman lie finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026. Gidans pratik profesionel, pa enn evaliasion sa formasion-la. Pa ti bizin enn kont pou paz-la.

sources.title: Helping Toddlers Develop Self-Control From 24–36 Months
sources.publisher: ZERO TO THREE
sources.claim: Soutenir kontrol bann inpilsion ki ankor pe devlope, enn langaz kourt avek bann zes ek bann tour partaze adapte. Bann group laz formasion-la bann gid planifikasion, pa bann nivo performans obligatwar.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa dokiman lie finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026. Servi diskision devlopman-la dan enn fason selektif. Formasion-la exkli bann kalin sirpriz, aret enn zanfan fizikman ek bann sizesion pou les li tousel.

sources.title: Toddler Tantrums 101: Why They Happen and What You Can Do
sources.publisher: ZERO TO THREE
sources.claim: Soutenir preparasion, bann swa reel, bann limit kourt ek enn lien ki reponn bann bezwen san promet enn kalm imedia.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa dokiman lie finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026. Formasion-la pa adopte bann limit kategorik baze lor dat nesans ouswa enn deklarasion ki bizin devers lakoler.

sources.title: Baby and toddler cues: in pictures
sources.publisher: Raising Children Network
sources.claim: Soutenir obzervasion bann invitasion pou interaksion, bann signal poz ek bann sanzman partisipasion, an verifyan konteks zanfan-la ek so lafami.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa dokiman lie finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026. Gid ofisiel 0–18 mwa ek version angle pou inprime finn lir. Bann zimaz aksesib par lien, pa kopie; bann signal individiel pa bann test diagnostik.

sources.title: Soothing a crying baby: in pictures
sources.publisher: Raising Children Network
sources.claim: Soutenir bann verifikasion swin, konfor, douler ouswa maladi, demann led enn adilt ek zame sekwe enn bebe.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa dokiman lie finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026. Pa servi kouma enn formasion pou nouri, anvlop, manipil, swagn medikalman ouswa fer dormi enn bebe. Bann prosedir swin ek somey an sekirite aprouve reste neseser.

sources.title: Overstimulated baby, toddler or child: signs and what to do
sources.publisher: Raising Children Network
sources.claim: Soutenir bann diferans individiel dan tolerans ek rediksion bann son, aktivite ouswa manipilasion ki melanze, an obzervan repons-la.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa dokiman lie finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026. Formasion-la exkli bann konsign pou anvlop enn bebe, kouver enn pouset ouswa servi enn port-bebe, ek li pa preskrir enn tretman sensoriel.

sources.title: Helping toddlers learn about feelings
sources.publisher: Raising Children Network; Karitane and UNSW
sources.claim: Soutenir enn prezans pre adapte, respe pou enn tipti zanfan ki refiz kontak fizik ek enn retour ver lansegnman kan partisipasion posib.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa dokiman lie finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026. Transkripsion ofisiel konplet finn lir; atribision paz-la finn verifye. Lektir video ek bann sou-tit pa finn teste dan enn fason indepandan.

sources.title: Emotions and play: preschoolers
sources.publisher: Raising Children Network
sources.claim: Soutenir bann zwe kot fer sanblan, bann mo lemosion ki pe devlope ek enn partisipasion varyab avek soutien adilt pandan bann lane preskoler.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa dokiman lie finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026. Laz 3–5 an dan sours-la enn gidans larz, pa enn evaliasion valide bann etap devlopman. Bann aktivite orizinal formasion-la osi adapte avek sak zanfan sis an.

sources.title: Self-regulation in children and teenagers
sources.publisher: Raising Children Network
sources.claim: Soutenir bann kapasite ki depann lor konteks ek demann konsey profesionel pou bann konsern ki persiste, repli, danze ouswa lefe lor lavi toulezour.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa dokiman lie finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026. Bann deskripsion referans ver bann spesialis dan Lostrali bizin adapte lokalman; bann prosedir irzans ek proteksion zanfan sorti dan bann prosedir aktiel servis-la.

sources.title: What Is Co-Regulation?
sources.publisher: Child Mind Institute
sources.claim: Soutenir konsians adilt lor so prop leta, montre lexanp, bann diferans detres ek lintrodiksion bann soutien familie avan enn kriz.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa dokiman lie finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026. Gidans piblik revize par enn klinisien. Formasion-la exkli kontak viziel/fizik obligatwar ek pa dedwir bann lefe niron mirwar ouswa ormon dan enn interaksion individiel.

sources.title: How Can We Help Kids With Self-Regulation?
sources.publisher: Child Mind Institute
sources.claim: Soutenir enn pratik adapte pou enn kapasite presi ek enn soutien adilt ki aziste progresivman.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa dokiman lie finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026. Pa enn norm konpetans baze lor dat nesans ni enn prev ki rekonfor adapte kree depandans.

sources.title: Healthy Minds, Thriving Kids Pre-K: Educator Guide
sources.publisher: Child Mind Institute
sources.claim: Soutenir lexanp adilt, bann ti pratik repete ek itilizasion bann kapasite dan bann routinn toulezour. Lexanp Sofia dan formasion-la azout bann verifikasion explisit lor akse avek kominikasion ek repons adilt.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa dokiman lie finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026. Gid konplet 21 paz finn lir. Bann materyel program avek enn mark pa enn prev ki sa formasion personel adapte la finn evalie. Zis bann lien; okenn ilistrasion founiser pa finn repwodir.

sources.title: Having Big Feelings: Healthy Minds, Thriving Kids Pre-K
sources.publisher: Child Mind Institute
sources.claim: Ofer enn video opsionel pou preskoler ek bann resours edikater pou explore bann lemosion ek bann swa pou fer fas avek zot pandan bann moman konfortab.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa dokiman lie finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026. Paz epizod ofisiel ek dire 6:26 finn verifye. Enn travay vizionaz pou adilt ek enn alternativ ekrir disponib; lektir/sou-tit pa finn teste dan enn fason indepandan.

sources.title: Should I Get Care for My Child?
sources.publisher: Child Mind Institute
sources.claim: Soutenir bann obzervasion presi lor frekans, lintansite, dire, konteks ek partisipasion kan pe konsider bann konsey siplemanter.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa dokiman lie finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026. Pa enn limit pou referans lekol ouswa enn gid irzans. Pa atann enn mwa, enn kantite fixe levennman ouswa enn diagnoz avan demann led neseser.

sources.title: Things That Will Help Me Stay Calm – Infants
sources.publisher: National Center for Pyramid Model Innovations
sources.claim: Soutenir enn interaksion adilt adapte, obzervasion bann signal ek bann routinn swin familie pou bann bebe.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa dokiman lie finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026. Paz ofisiel ek PDF enn paz finn lir san koneksion kont. Adilt-la aplik gidans-la; pa atann ki bann bebe servi enn tablo. Sa pa enn formasion somey an sekirite.

sources.title: Responsive Routines Inventory
sources.publisher: National Center for Pyramid Model Innovations
sources.claim: Soutenir bann routinn fleksib pou bebe/tipti zanfan, enn partenarya avek lafami, enn adilt swin referans ek enn larive avek soutien.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa dokiman lie finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026. PDF wit paz finn lir; dat dokiman-la se 22 Septam 2023. Li pa ranplas bann prosedir aktiel pou swin an sekirite, somey an sekirite ouswa twalet.

sources.title: Using Visuals to Support Children in the Early Learning Environment
sources.publisher: National Center for Pyramid Model Innovations
sources.claim: Soutenir bann zimaz ki ena sans, bann progranm aksesib kot zot servi, montre kan enn aktivite fini ek bann sanzman, ek bann letiket dan enn lang familie.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa dokiman lie finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026. Paz ek gid set paz Zin 2025 finn lir san koneksion kont. Bann zouti aster/apre formasion-la explik bann sekans ki vre; bann bezwen debaz, lien ek kominikasion zame bann rekonpans avek kondisyon. Zis bann ilistrasion orizinal formasion-la.

sources.title: Teaching Tools for Young Children: Using Function-Informed Support to Address Challenging Behavior within Routines, fourth edition
sources.publisher: Lentini and colleagues; National Center for Pyramid Model Innovations
sources.claim: Soutenir prevansion adapte avek enn routinn, lansegnman, repons adilt, partenarya avek lafami ek swivi, ek gid striktir plan orizinal Leo.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa dokiman lie finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026. Gid 91 paz Zin 2025 finn lir. Li pa enn formasion pou determinn fonksion enn konportman, li pa ranplas enn evaliasion formel ek li pa sifi pou bann konsern grav ek persistan. Zis enn lien; plan formasion orizinal, pa enn model kopie.

sources.title: Visual Daily Schedule
sources.publisher: Conscious Discipline
sources.claim: Lexanp enn program nomme lor bann routinn previzib ek vizib. Soutenir lexplorasion itilizasion pratik enn progranm; formasion-la exiz separeman enn kominikasion individiel ki ena sans.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa dokiman lie finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026. Deskripsion piblik finn lir; kapav bizin enn kont gratis pou telechargman. Formasion-la pa kopie version inprimab-la ni adopte enn deklarasion iniversel ki bann zanfan pans zis an zimaz.

sources.title: Toddler Bedroom: Safe Place
sources.publisher: Conscious Discipline
sources.claim: Enn lexanp avek enn mark lor kalme avek soutien adilt ek ansegn kouma servi enn lespas avan detres. Li gid refleksion lor disponibilite adilt, pa enn sekans obligatwar.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa dokiman lie finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026. Paz piblik finn lir; lektir video pa finn teste. Safe Place ek so bann letap bann materyel avek enn mark, pa bann prev indepandan lefikasite. Pena personaz ouswa fraz kopie, ni respirasion ouswa kontak fizik obligatwar.

sources.title: Feeling Faces: Happy, Sad, Angry, Scared
sources.publisher: Conscious Discipline
sources.claim: Ofer bann ilistrasion program opsionel pou bann konversasion lor lemosion. Formasion-la aksepte linsirtitid, lavi prive, plizier interpretasion ek kominikasion san bann mo.
sources.accessNote: Paz ofisiel ouswa dokiman lie finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026. Paz ofisiel ek PDF sink paz finn ouver san koneksion kont. Bann ilistrasion proteze founiser-la pa inklir, tradir ouswa met anba enn lot mark. Nom enn lemosion zame enn kondisyon pou gagn rekonfor.

sources.title: Preschool Promise Child Assessments Technical Report 2017–2018
sources.publisher: Mary Fuhs, University of Dayton (September 2018); linked by Conscious Discipline
sources.claim: Raport enn lasosiasion ant fidelite laplikasion ek bann pwin fonksion egzekitif dan printan dan 45 klas partisipan an 2017–2018, an azistan pou bann kovariab mezire.
sources.accessNote: Rapor 23 paz ki ena enn lien ofisiel finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026. Li dekrir enn kontra lokal avek Learn to Earn Dayton; enn lien depi Conscious Discipline pa vedir ki program-la finn komann rapor-la. Sa evaliasion par obzervasion la pa enn test avek repartision aleatwar pou sak pratik, enn test sa formasion-la ouswa enn prev enn mekanism servo.

evidenceNotes.title: Gidans profesionel ek bann laplikasion orizinal dan klas
evidenceNotes.text: ZERO TO THREE, Child Mind Institute, NCPMI, bann resours aktivite Harvard ek Raising Children Network ofer bann explikasion profesionel, bann sintez ek bann lexanp pratik. Zot gid bann desizion adilt ansegne, me zot pa bann test sa bann fraz, zwe ouswa zouti-la. Tou bann sitiasion, fraz ek dispozision zouti formasion-la orizinal; okenn founiser pa aprouv formasion-la.

evidenceNotes.title: Bann materyel avek enn mark bann lexanp, pa bann prev indepandan
evidenceNotes.text: Conscious Discipline enn program edikatif nomme. Bann resours swazir gid refleksion lor previzibilite, bann lespas avek soutien adilt ek vokabiler lemosion. So bann letap avek enn mark, personaz ek explikasion bann leta servo pa adopte kouma enn kad diagnostik ni kopie dan formasion-la. Bann materyel Pre-K Child Mind osi idantifie kouma enn program; zot pa prezante kouma enn evaliasion indepandan sa formasion-la. Akse gratis pa vedir re-itilizasion san limit.

evidenceNotes.title: Resers indepandan ek bann limit bann konklizion
evidenceNotes.text: Sintez bann prev ek program resers EEF tret bann prev resers pli larz separeman avek bann materyel pratik bann founiser. Bann prev lor bann intervansion pandan premie lane reste limite ek inegal; ena bann mank dan bann prev spesifik lor ko-regilasion ek bann pli tipti zanfan. Enn rapor lie avek Conscious Discipline dekrir enn lasosiasion obzerve ek aziste dan 45 klas, pa enn test avek repartision aleatwar pou sak pratik. Okenn sa bann sours-la pa valid sa formasion 75 minit la dan enn fason indepandan, garanti enn rezilta ouswa etabli enn lefe neronal apartir enn fraz.

evidenceNotes.title: Sekirite lokal ek zizman individiel reste esansiel
evidenceNotes.text: Enn soutien ki pran kont resers pa ranplas bann swin bebe aprouve, bann plan kominikasion individiel, sirveyans, evaliasion lasante, repons irzans ouswa proteksion zanfan. Bann group laz bann sours diferan; bann gran group planifikasion sa formasion-la pa bann test bann etap devlopman. Formasion-la exkli kontak fizik ouswa regar forse, refi swin, inior detres, bann teknik restriktif inprovize ek bann konsign tretman klinik.

evidenceNotes.title: Akse, drwa doter ek vizionaz opsionel
evidenceNotes.text: Bann nouvo paz ek dokiman bann founiser finn verifye le 6 Oktob 2026. Bann nouvo video azoute finn verifye atraver zot paz, resours akonpagnman ek transkripsion; zot lektir pa finn teste dan enn fason indepandan. Sak video formasion ena enn travay vizionaz pou adilt ek enn alternativ ekrir. Telechargman progranm Conscious Discipline kapav demann enn kont gratis. Bann grafik, zistwar, model ek logo bann founiser aksesib par lien olye repwodir ouswa tradir.
